newsitem.title: USA: Genesis Development says in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Genesis Development says in joint venture.

text.p: Genesis Development and Construction Ltd said Wednesday it entered into a joint venture to carry out a land development and construction project in Rehovot, Israel.
The company and certain investors will each have a 50 percent interest in the joint venture. The investors will pay $6 million for their 50 percent interest.

The company said the investors' participation is subject to the modifying of current zoning plans to increase the number of units constructed on the land -- a 20 acre parcel about 15 miles from Tel Aviv.
Genesis said it will seek permission for a larger number of residential units than the 400 that the Israel land administration has recommended.
The company previously reported the acquisition from the Israel Land Administration of rights to the land.
The company said it expects to complete construction of the project in about 5 years.
Genesis Development is an Israeli company with a primary focus on residential and public properties in Israel.
